data.claim: Webhook authenticity via the verify API; deliveries can be late, duplicated or missing.
notes: verify-webhook-signature takes webhook_event as JSON, so PayPal checks a re-serialised event, not the exact received bytes; the raw bytes are kept (raw/webhooks/*.body) and the exact-bytes concern is recorded, not solved
simulator events use the mock webhook ID WEBHOOK_ID, so FAILURE is expected for them (F11); they are excluded from the verdict
resource IDs are read by event-name family from the documented resource schemas; the event-names page shows no sample payloads [pending D11]
a resent event shows up as a duplicate marked induced_by_resend
the event list was read with page_size=50; later pages were not followed
